requirements.quote: configurations shall be proposed at time of bidding.  Manufacturer  shall include plan view drawings of alternate configurations with bid.
requirements.text: Propose configurations and include plan view drawings with the bid.

requirements.quote: Switchgear shall have single doors placed at locations shown on the plan-view.
requirements.text: Switchgear must have single doors as per the plan-view.

requirements.quote: Keyed door handles with ASSA cores approved by Owner.  Owner shall provide the keys.
requirements.text: Doors must have keyed handles with ASSA cores approved by the owner.

requirements.quote: Circuit breaker shall be able to pass through the door.
requirements.text: Doors must allow circuit breakers to pass through.

requirements.quote: Sufficiently braced and reinforced steel to provide a solid contact/seal when closed and avoid warping when opening and closing.
requirements.text: Doors must be braced and reinforced to ensure proper sealing and avoid warping.

requirements.quote: Equipped with “full-open” door closers with a latch to hold door open.
requirements.text: Doors must have full-open closers with a latch to hold them open.

requirements.quote: Panic hardware.
requirements.text: Doors must include panic hardware.

requirements.quote: Provide hinged, gasketed, full length, weatherproof, rear doors, complete with three-point latch and provisions for padlocking.  Hinge shall be on the right side (back view).  Each door shall have a sign stating the electrical hazards.
requirements.text: Rear doors must be hinged, gasketed, weatherproof, with a three-point latch, padlocking provisions, and hazard signs.

requirements.quote: All hazard signs shall be in accordance with ANSI Z535.2-2007.
requirements.text: Hazard signs must comply with ANSI Z535.2-2007.

requirements.quote: The stationary structure for walk-through switchgear shall consist of indoor-class switchgear compartments located in a weatherproof steel housing.
requirements.text: Walk-through switchgear must have indoor-class compartments in weatherproof steel housing.

requirements.quote: The switchgear assembly shall consist of individual vertical sections housing various combinations of circuit breakers and auxiliaries, assembled to form a rigid metal-clad switchgear assembly.
requirements.text: Switchgear assembly must have vertical sections for circuit breakers and auxiliaries, forming a rigid metal-clad assembly.

requirements.quote: All sections housing circuit breakers shall be welded.
requirements.text: Sections for circuit breakers must be welded.

requirements.quote: Metal side sheets shall provide grounded barriers between adjacent structures and solid removable metal barriers shall isolate the major primary sections of each circuit.
requirements.text: Metal side sheets must provide grounded barriers, and removable barriers must isolate primary circuit sections.

requirements.quote: The structure shall be fabricated from steel sheets and reinforced with structural steel members where necessary:
requirements.text: Structure must be made of steel sheets and reinforced as needed.

requirements.quote: 16” on center interlocking panel construction:
requirements.text: Panels must have 16-inch center interlocking construction.

requirements.quote: Floor:   ¼” steel
requirements.text: Floor panels must be ¼-inch steel.

requirements.quote: Exterior walls:  12 gauge
requirements.text: Exterior walls must be 12-gauge steel.

requirements.quote: Interior walls:  16 gauge
requirements.text: Interior walls must be 16-gauge steel.

requirements.quote: Ceiling and roof:  as required for design
requirements.text: Ceiling and roof must meet design requirements.

requirements.quote: 36” on center welded or bolted panel construction:
requirements.text: Panels must have 36-inch center welded or bolted construction.

requirements.quote: Floor:  ¼” steel
requirements.text: Floor panels must be ¼-inch steel.
